name: Risk Analysis & Financial Mathematics
description: Probability theory, stochastic processes, and quantitative risk modelling applied to financial systems. Covers value-at-risk, Monte Carlo simulation, and actuarial risk measures.

name: Combinatorial Optimization
description: Integer programming, graph algorithms, and NP-hard problem analysis. Topics include network flows, matching theory, the travelling salesman problem, and approximation algorithms.

name: Computational Mathematics
description: Numerical methods, linear algebra algorithms, and scientific computing. Emphasis on floating-point arithmetic, iterative solvers, and matrix decompositions (LU, QR, SVD).

name: Operations Research
description: Linear programming, the simplex method, duality theory, and decision modelling. Applied to supply chain optimisation, resource allocation, and scheduling problems.
